title: Introduce yourself
goal: Say your name, where you are from, where you live and what you do.
scenario: You just met the learner at a language exchange (intercambio) in a café in Madrid. You are curious about them.

title: At the café
goal: Order something to drink and eat, ask the price, ask for the bill.
scenario: You are a friendly waiter (camarero) at a small café in Sevilla. The learner is the customer. Stay in the role.

title: Your day
goal: Describe a normal day: when you get up, eat, work and what you do in the evening.
scenario: You and the learner are friends chatting about your daily routines.

title: Family & friends
goal: Talk about the people in your life: family members, friends, what they are like.
scenario: You are showing each other photos on your phones and talking about family and friends.

title: Last weekend
goal: Tell what you did last weekend using the past tense (fui, hice, vi, comí).
scenario: It is Monday morning. You ask the learner about their weekend and share yours.

title: Free conversation
goal: Talk about anything you like — Sofía follows your lead.
scenario: A relaxed chat. Follow the learner's interests and ask about their life.
